prices._about: Official list prices per 1M tokens in force when the runs were made (late October 2026). in = uncached input, hit = cache-hit input, out = output (incl. reasoning / thinking). Costs are computed per API request from the relay logs by scripts/cost_check.py: OpenAI requests over 272K input tokens use OpenAI's long-context row, OpenAI cache writes are billed at the 30-min write rate and Anthropic cache writes at the 5-min write rate; tokens counted by the CLI but with no usage record in the relay are added at the base rates. Other vendors' cache writes are billed at their input price; Doubao cache storage and DeepSeek off-peak discounts are not applied.
